claims.claim: A gateway omitting tenant cache partitioning or allowing another tenant's cache salt enables above-chance inference of whether a chosen prompt prefix was processed by that tenant.

claims.not_established: There are no KV tensors, GPU, vLLM server, network jitter, batching, or model inference. Cold work is 1,200 SHA-256 iterations, so the timing separation is artificial.
